direct_leakage_audit.finding: Pseudo-labels were strictly derived from unlabelled Djinni candidate pairs, not from held-out test data or ground-truth labels.

indirect_leakage_audit.finding: Multiple model architectures and tuning configurations were iteratively evaluated against held_out_test_v1.parquet (N=1759) during Phase 12F. This sequential re-use induces post-selection bias (Freedman paradox / adaptive overfitting to test evaluation), invalidating the 50.26% metric as an unbiased out-of-sample estimate.

remediation: All future evaluations must enforce strict quarantine: held-out test splits may only be evaluated once after final model freezing; iterative model selection must rely solely on cross-validation or isolated validation splits.
